At the second meeting of the Contract and Equality Study Group, organized by Associate Professor Shinohara of Konan University, I gave a presentation titled "The Regulation of Exclusionary Private Monopolization and Economic Welfare."

Many of the participants work in other fields such as civil law, administrative law, and constitutional law, so I heard questions from perspectives different from those of competition law scholars. It was a very valuable experience. Thank you.
